document.title: SRS: Cable TV Package Purchase System
document.text:
# 1 Introduction
## 1.1 Purpose
This SRS specifies the requirements of the Cable TV Package Purchase System (TV2P) for its procurement. It is intended for the customer service managers of the cable TV company, who will contract its development, and for the suppliers that will bid for it.
## 1.2 Scope
The Cable TV Package Purchase System (TV2P) manages the contracting of cable TV programming packages. Purchases are made by telephone, so the customer talks to an operator of the customer service center, who registers the purchase in TV2P. TV2P handles the information about the packages and their availability, the registration of purchases and rejections, the validation of the phone line, the payment in full by telephone bill or credit card (partial payments are not accepted), the management of operators and packages, and the daily report. TV2P does not handle the billing of the contracted packages or the installation of the equipment at the customer's home.
## 1.3 Product Overview
### 1.3.1 Product perspective
The system has the following interfaces.
- Telephone company line qualification service (LQS), see [REF-01]. - Credit card payment gateway, see [REF-02].
### 1.3.3 User characteristics
TV2P operators come from many different social environments, and therefore their computing skills are extremely variable. The system must therefore display a help text on every screen.
### 1.3.4 Limitations
Only the packages that are registered and available on the date of the purchase can be offered. The customer must have a credit card or a telephone line. The customer must pay the full price, and partial payments are not accepted. The customer service center operates from 8 AM to 9 PM.
## 1.4 Definitions
**Package:** a set of cable TV programs sold at a fee.
**Purchase:** the contracting of a package by a customer.
**Rejection:** a purchase that is not completed, and the system shall record the reason for every rejection.
## 1.5 SRS Overview
This SRS follows the outline of ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018. The sections of the outline that do not appear have been omitted for simplicity; notice that this reason is valid only in the framework of this academic course. Requirements are identified as FUN(xx) for functional, PER(xx) for performance, and QUA(xx) for quality requirements. Each requirement is a singular sentence that uses the verb "shall".
# 2 References
[REF-01] Line Qualification Service Interface, version 2.3, Telephone Company Technical Services, 2023.
[REF-02] Payment Gateway API Reference, version 4.0, Payment Gateway Provider, 2024.
# 3 Specific requirements
## 3.1 Functions
FUN(01) When the system starts, it shall display a menu with the options: Purchase package, Manage packages, Manage operators, Daily report, etc. FUN(02) The system shall allow the registration, modification, and deletion of operators and packages. FUN(03) The system must show the operator the characteristics and availability of each package on the date of the purchase. FUN(04) The system shall allow the operator to select the credit card or the telephone bill as the payment method of a purchase. FUN(05) The system shall accept a phone line only if it satisfies the technical criteria defined in [REF-04]. FUN(06) If the phone line validation fails, the system shall reject the purchase and store the reason for the rejection. FUN(07) The system shall allow the customer to pay the price of a package in two instalments. FUN(08) The system shall list the most popular packages first when it shows the available packages. FUN(09) The system shall schedule the installation of the decoder at the customer's home. FUN(10) The system shall produce the daily report at 9 PM, with the purchases, the rejections, or all the records, as selected by the operator. FUN(11) The system shall verify that the credit card has enough funds before the charge is sent. FUN(12) When the customer selects the credit card, the system shall send the charge of the price of the package to the payment gateway. FUN(13) When the customer selects the telephone bill, the system shall register the price of the package to be charged in the telephone bill of the customer. FUN(14) The system shall be implemented with an Oracle 19c database and a Java Swing user interface.
## 3.2 Performance requirements
PER(01) The system shall complete the validation of a phone line within 10 seconds.
## 3.7 Software system attributes
QUA(01) The system shall record the date and time of every purchase and rejection. QUA(02) The system shall make the purchase process efficient for the operators.
# 5 Appendixes
## 5.1 Assumptions and dependencies
The system assumes that the date and time of the host computer are correct. It depends on the services of the telephone company and of the payment gateway.
## 5.2 Acronyms and abbreviations
**SRS:** Software Requirements Specification.
**TV2P:** Cable TV Package Purchase System.
